agent_note: Heavily dialogue-dominated sample (19/25) -- Goodreads selection for this book favors romantic and banter lines. All five event-narration quotes are past-tense third-person limited narration; no present-tense event narration anywhere in the sample. Quotation marks survive on roughly half the quotes; where absent I used direct address, vocatives, and colloquial register (recorded per quote). Event count is exactly at the >=5 threshold, so q09073 is load-bearing: it pairs past-tense summary about specific characters with a present-tense aphorism, and a gnomic read would leave only 4 event quotes and force abstention. q09082 and q09092 are the other soft calls (dialogue vs. present-tense interior state); both were read as speech, and neither was counted as present event-narration.
